WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id,
           m.position,
           COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m
      ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position
)
SELECT member_id,
       position,
       attendance_count,
       1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share
FROM member_attendance
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
